column1: # AllocationRules.csv — Financial Allocation rules for financialAllocation.scala (Step 6)
# SCHEMA:
#   sourceNominalAccount — nominal account prefix of the overhead source to be allocated
#                          (balances starting with this prefix are the source pool)
#   sourceAgency         — legal entity ID of the overhead source agency
#                          (use "*" to match any agency with balances in this account)
#   driverNominalAccount — nominal account prefix to use as the weighting driver
#                          (e.g. "EXP" means weight by each program's share of total expense)
#   receiverAgency       — legal entity ID of the receiving agency
#                          (use "*" to allocate to all agencies that have driver balances)
#   divisorGrain         — explicit denominator key
#   driverGrain          — numerator/receiver key
# STANDARD VOCABULARY:
#   sourceNominalAccount = Movement Key prefix (balance bucket designator)
#   sourceAgency / receiverAgency = Legal Entity ID
# HOW IT WORKS:
#   For each year
#     1. Identifies all balances matching sourceNominalAccount + sourceAgency (the source pool)
#     2. Calculates each receiver's weight = receiver driver balance / total driver balance
#     3. Generates a debit SJE to each receiver (receiver's share of the source amount)
#     4. Generates a credit SJE to the source (zeroing it)
#   Net financial position is unchanged — only distribution changes.
# PRIOR-DAY DIVISOR DESIGN (Paper 1 §3.2 — single-pass universality):
#   The driver balance (divisor) is read from yesterday's LDGR time partition B;
#   the current allocation source pool is partition C.  Both are consumed in the
#   same ordered CKB flow
column2: so allocation is a single pass over B+C
